verses.geez:
ወዕቀቡ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትግበሩ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ ዘእኤዝዘክሙ ፡ አነ ፡ ዮም ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሕየዉ ፡ ወትትባዝኁ ፡ ወትባኡ ፡
                  ትትወረሱ ፡ ምድረ ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአበዊክሙ ።
verses.translation: Ye shall observe to do all the commands which I charge you to-day, that ye may live and be multiplied, and enter in and inherit the land, which the Lord your God sware to give to your fathers.

translations.lxx: Ye shall observe to do all the commands which I charge you to-day, that ye may live and be multiplied, and enter in and inherit the land, which the Lord your God sware to give to your fathers.
translations.kjv: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
translations.ron: "Siliţi-vă să împliniţi toate poruncile acestea pe care vi le dau eu astăzi, ca să fiţi vii şi să vă înmulţiţi şi să vă duceţi să luaţi în stăpânire pământul cel bun pe care cu jurământ 1-a făgăduit Domnul Dumnezeul părinţilor voştri.

verses.geez:
ወተዘከር ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሰደከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ከመ ፡ ያሕምምከ ፡ ወከመ
                  ፡ ያመክርከ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ያእምር ፡ ልበከ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ተዐቅብ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ወለእመ ፡ አልቦ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee in the wilderness, that he might afflict thee, and try thee, and that the things in thine heart might be made manifest, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments or no.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt remember all the way which the Lord thy God led thee in the wilderness, that he might afflict thee, and try thee, and that the things in thine heart might be made manifest, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments or no.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
translations.ron: Să-ţi aduci aminte de toată calea pe care te-a povăţuit Domnul Dumnezeul tău prin pustie de acum patruzeci de ani, ca să te smerească, ca să te încerce şi ca să afle ce este în inima ta şi de ai să păzeşti sau nu poruncile Lui.

verses.geez:
ወአሕመመከ ፡ ወአርኀበከ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ መና ፡ ሴሰየከ ፡ ዘኢያአምሩ ፡ አበዊከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያርኢከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢኮነ ፡
                  በእክል ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ዘየሐዩ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ አላ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ቃል ፡ እንተ ፡ ትወፅእ ፡ እምነ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ የሐዩ
                  ፡ ሰብእ ።
verses.translation: And he afflicted thee and straitened thee with hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thy fathers knew not; that he might teach thee that man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God shall man live.

translations.lxx: And he afflicted thee and straitened thee with hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thy fathers knew not; that he might teach thee that man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God shall man live.
translations.kjv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
translations.ron: Te-a smerit, te-a pedepsit cu foamea şi te-a hrănit cu mana pe care nu o cunoşteai şi pe care nu o cunoşteau nici părinţii tăi, ca să-ţi arate că nu numai cu pâine trăieşte omul, ci că omul trăieşte şi cu tot Cuvântul ce iese din gura Domnului.

verses.geez: አልባሲከኒ ፡ ኢበልየ ፡ በላዕሌከ ፡ ወእገሪከኒ ፡ ኢረስሐ ፡ ናሁ ፡ አርብዓ ፡ ዓም ።
verses.translation: Thy garments grew not old from off thee, thy shoes were not worn from off thee, thy feet were not painfully hardened, lo! these forty years.

translations.lxx: Thy garments grew not old from off thee, thy shoes were not worn from off thee, thy feet were not painfully hardened, lo! these forty years.
translations.kjv: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
translations.ron: Haina ta nu s-a învechit pe tine şi piciorul tău n-a căpătat bătături în aceşti patruzeci de ani.

verses.geez: ወአእምር ፡ በልብከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይጌሥጽ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ወልዶ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይጌሥጸከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt know in thine heart, that as if any man should chasten his son, so the Lord thy God will chasten thee.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt know in thine heart, that as if any man should chasten his son, so the Lord thy God will chasten thee.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
translations.ron: Dar să ştii în inima ta că Domnul Dumnezeul tău te învaţă, cum învaţă omul pe fiul său.

verses.geez: ወዕቀብ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሑር ፡ በፍኖቱ ፡ ወትፍርሆ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt keep the commands of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt keep the commands of the Lord thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
translations.kjv: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
translations.ron: Păzeşte dar poruncile Domnului Dumnezeului tău, umblând în căile Lui şi temându-te de El.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ያበውአከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ቡርክት ፡ ወብዝኅት ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሓይዝተ ፡ ማይ ፡
                  ወዐዘቃቲሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ቀላይ ፡ ወይትከዐው ፡ ዉስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ወውስተ ፡ አድባር ።
verses.translation: For the Lord thy God will bring thee into a good and extensive land, where there are torrents of waters, and fountains of deep places issuing through the plains and through the mountains:

translations.lxx: For the Lord thy God will bring thee into a good and extensive land, where there are torrents of waters, and fountains of deep places issuing through the plains and through the mountains:
translations.kjv: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
translations.ron: Că Domnul Dumnezeul tău te va duce într-o ţară bună, ţară de curgeri de apă, de izvoare şi de ape adânci, care ţâşnesc în văi şi în munţi;

verses.geez: ምድረ ፡ ስርናይ ፡ ወስገም ፡ ወአዕጻደ ፡ ወይን ፡ ወበለስ ፡ ወሮማን ፡ ምድረ ፡ ኤልያስ ፡ ዘዘይት ፡ ወመዓር ፤
verses.translation: a land of wheat and barley, wherein are vines, figs, pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;

translations.lxx: a land of wheat and barley, wherein are vines, figs, pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey;
translations.kjv: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
translations.ron: Ţară în care se află: grâu, orz, viţă de vie, smochine şi rodii;

verses.geez:
ምድር ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢኮነት ፡ በአስተአክሎ ፡ ዘትበልዖ ፡ ለእክልከ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘተኀጥእ ፡ ምንተኒ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ምድር ፡
                  እንተ ፡ እበኒሃ ፡ ኀፂን ፡ ወእምውስተ ፡ አድባሪሃ ፡ ይኤልድዎ ፡ ለብርት ።
verses.translation: a land on which thou shalt not eat thy bread with poverty, and thou shalt not want any thing upon it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of its mountains thou shalt dig brass.

translations.lxx: a land on which thou shalt not eat thy bread with poverty, and thou shalt not want any thing upon it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of its mountains thou shalt dig brass.
translations.kjv: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
translations.ron: Într-o ţară unde sunt măslini, untdelemn şi miere, în care fără lipsă vei mânca pâinea ta şi nu vei duce lipsă de nimic; în care pietrele au fier şi din munţii căreia vei scoate aramă.

verses.geez: ወብላዕ ፡ ወጽገብ ፡ ወባርኮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ቡርክት ፡ እንተ ፡ ወሀበከ ።
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat and be filled, and shalt bless the Lord thy God on the good land, which he has given thee.

translations.lxx: And thou shalt eat and be filled, and shalt bless the Lord thy God on the good land, which he has given thee.
translations.kjv: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
translations.ron: Când însă vei mânca şi te vei sătura, să binecuvântezi pe Domnul Dumnezeul tău pentru tara cea bună pe care ţi-a dat-o.

verses.geez:
ወዑቅ ፡ ርእሰከ ፡ ወኢትርስዖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትዕቀብ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ወፍትሖ ፡ ወኵነኔሁ ፡ ኵሎ ፡
                  ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ።
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou forget not the Lord thy God, so as not to keep his commands, and his judgments, and ordinances, which I command thee this day:

translations.lxx: Take heed to thyself that thou forget not the Lord thy God, so as not to keep his commands, and his judgments, and ordinances, which I command thee this day:
translations.kjv: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
translations.ron: Fereşte-te de a uita pe Domnul Dumnezeul tău şi de a nu păzi poruncile Lui, legile Lui şi hotărârile Lui pe care ti le spun eu astăzi.

verses.geez: ዮጊ ፡ ሶበ ፡ በላዕከ ፡ ወጸገብከ ፡ ወነደቀ ፡ አብያተ ፡ ሠናያነ ፡ ወነበርከ ፡ ውስቴቶሙ ፤
verses.translation: lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt in them;

translations.lxx: lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt in them;
translations.kjv: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
translations.ron: Când vei mânca şi te vei sătura şi îţi vei face case frumoase şi vei trăi în ele;

verses.geez:
ወበዝኃ ፡ ለከ ፡ አባግዒከ ፡ ወአልህምቲከ ፡ ወሶበ ፡ በዝኀ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወርቅ ፡ ወብሩር ፡ ወበዝኀ ፡ ለከ ፡ ኵሉ ፡
                  ንዋይከ ፤
verses.translation: and thy oxen and thy sheep are multiplied to thee, and thy silver and thy gold are multiplied to thee, and all thy possessions are multiplied to thee,

translations.lxx: and thy oxen and thy sheep are multiplied to thee, and thy silver and thy gold are multiplied to thee, and all thy possessions are multiplied to thee,
translations.kjv: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
translations.ron: Când vei avea multe vite mari şi mărunte şi mult argint şi aur şi vei avea de toate la tine,

verses.geez:
ዮጊ ፡ ታዐቢ ፡ ልበከ ፡ ወትረስዖ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ዘአውፅአከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቤተ
                  ፡ ቅኔት ፤
verses.translation: thou shouldest be exalted in heart, and forget the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage:

translations.lxx: thou shouldest be exalted in heart, and forget the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage:
translations.kjv: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
translations.ron: Vezi să nu se mândrească inima ta şi să nu uiţi pe Domnul Dumnezeul tău Care te-a scos din Egipt, din casa robiei;

verses.geez:
ወወሰደከ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ዘዐቢይ ፡ ወግሩም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘአራዊተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ዘይነስክ ፡ ወዐቃርብት ፡ ወጽምእ ፡
                  ወአልቦ ፡ ማየ ፡ ለሰትይ ፡ ዘአውፅአ ፡ ለከ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ እብን ፡ ኰኵሕ ፡ ነቅዐ ፡ ማየ ፡ ጥዑም ።
verses.translation: who brought thee through that great and terrible wilderness, where is the biting serpent, and scorpion, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee a fountain of water out of the flinty rock:

translations.lxx: who brought thee through that great and terrible wilderness, where is the biting serpent, and scorpion, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee a fountain of water out of the flinty rock:
translations.kjv: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
translations.ron: Care te-a povăţuit prin pustiul cel mare şi groaznic, unde sunt şerpi veninoşi, scorpioni şi locuri arse de soare şi fără de apă;

verses.geez:
ዘሴሰየከ ፡ መና ፡ በገዳም ፡ ዘኢያአምሩ ፡ አበዊከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያሕምምከ ፡ ወያመክርከ ፡ ወያሠኒ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ በደኃሪ ፡
                  መዋዕሊከ ።
verses.translation: who fed thee with manna in the wilderness, which thou knewest not, and thy fathers knew not; that he might afflict thee, and thoroughly try thee, and do thee good in thy latter days.

translations.lxx: who fed thee with manna in the wilderness, which thou knewest not, and thy fathers knew not; that he might afflict thee, and thoroughly try thee, and do thee good in thy latter days.
translations.kjv: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
translations.ron: Care a scos pentru tine izvor din stânca de cremene, te-a hrănit în pustie cu mana pe care tu n-o cunoşteai şi n-o cunoşteau nici părinţii tăi, ca să te smerească şi să te încerce,

verses.geez: ወኢትበል ፡ በልብከ ፡ በጽንዕየ ፡ ወበኀይለ ፡ እዴየ ፡ ገበርኩ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ኅይለ ፡ ዐቢየ ።
verses.translation: Lest thou shouldest say in thine heart, My strength, and the power of mine hand have wrought for me this great wealth.

translations.lxx: Lest thou shouldest say in thine heart, My strength, and the power of mine hand have wrought for me this great wealth.
translations.kjv: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
translations.ron: Ca să-ţi facă bine în urmă şi ca să nu zici în inima ta: Puterea mea şi tăria mâinii mele mi-au adus bogăţia aceasta;

verses.geez:
ወተዘከሮ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ይሁበከ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያቅም ፡ ኪዳኖ ፡ ዘመሐለ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአበዊከ ፡ በከመ ፡ ዮም ።
verses.translation: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, that he gives thee strength to get wealth; even that he may establish his covenant, which the Lord sware to thy fathers, as at this day.

translations.lxx: But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, that he gives thee strength to get wealth; even that he may establish his covenant, which the Lord sware to thy fathers, as at this day.
translations.kjv: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
translations.ron: Ci ca să-ţi aduci aminte de Domnul Dumnezeul tău, că El îţi dă putere să faci bogăţie, ca să-Şi ţină, ca acum, legământul Lui, pe care cu jurământ l-a întărit cu părinţii tăi.

verses.geez:
ወለእመ ፡ ረሲዐ ፡ ረሳዕካሁ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወሖርከ ፡ ድኅረ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ወአምለካሆሙ ፡
                  ወሰገድከ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኣሰምዕ ፡ ላዕሌከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ሰማየ ፡ ወምድረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ጠፊአ ፡ ትጠፍእ ።
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and shouldest go after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall surely perish.

translations.lxx: And it shall come to pass if thou do at all forget the Lord thy God, and shouldest go after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall surely perish.
translations.kjv: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
translations.ron: Iar dacă vei uita pe Domnul Dumnezeul tău şi vei merge după dumnezeii altora, vei sluji acelora şi te vei închina lor, vă mărturisesc astăzi pe cer şi pe pământ că veţi pieri.

verses.geez:
በከመ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ደምሰሶሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምቅድመ ፡ ገጽክሙ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ትደመሰሱ ፡ እስመ ፡
                  ኢሰማዕክሙ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ።
verses.translation: As also the other nations which the Lord God destroys before your face, so shall ye perish, because ye hearkened not to the voice of the Lord your God.

translations.lxx: As also the other nations which the Lord God destroys before your face, so shall ye perish, because ye hearkened not to the voice of the Lord your God.
translations.kjv: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
translations.ron: Cum pier popoarele, pe care Domnul Dumnezeu le pierde dinaintea voastră, aşa veţi pieri şi voi, de nu veţi asculta glasul Domnului Dumnezeului vostru!"
